verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no consolidated dashboard listing every entity and state registration with its standing and upcoming deadlines. The per-company compliance calendar is a Partner API resource, which is a building block a developer would use to construct such a view, not the view itself. The doola dashboard is documented only for registered-agent mail access, and annual-report notifications are an adjacent alerting feature.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, one dashboard shows every entity and state registration with its standing and upcoming deadlines
